title: BHARATFORG Investor Relations - Bharat Forge Ltd - Alpha Spread
snippet: # Bharat Forge Ltd NSE:BHARATFORG. Bharat Forge Ltd makes forged metal parts and machined components used in vehicles and heavy equipment. The company sits in the middle of the industrial supply chain: it takes metal, forges it into precise shapes, and finishes parts that customers can install directly in their own products. What makes Bharat Forge different is its role as a specialist in heavy-duty metal forming rather than a broad machinery maker. That gives it a mix of cyclical exposure to auto and industrial demand and longer-term value from engineering know-how, customer qualification, and the difficulty of replacing a trusted parts supplier.
